maddeler.e:
تستشهدين (form X)
# تَسْتَشْهِدِينَ (tastašhidīna) /tas.taʃ.hi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# تُسْتَشْهَدِينَ (tustašhadīna) /tus.taʃ.ha.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
